name: Haitoku Shirene - Anata no Shiranai Naraku no Soko
original_name: 背徳シレネ - あなたの知らない奈落の底
source:
You must not set foot in this story with a pure and loving heart.
When you pursue the forbidden secret of the girl, you will be struck down to the depths of hell...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE247036.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你不该带着纯洁而充满爱的心踏入这个故事。
当你追寻女孩的禁忌秘密时，将被击落地狱深处……

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE247036.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
